　◆Gameplay Rebalance
　【Battle Balance】
　　▼Buster
　　　・During battles with COM Monsters, we adjusted the AI of CPU Busters to be stronger than before.

　　　・We added an area where you take damage if you continue to stay around the Soul Pot.

　　・The interval for switching the stage of Episode Match has been changed from 1 hour to 30 minutes.

　　・Fixed a bug where gear customization was not reflected in training.
　　・Fixed a bug where damage was taken even when invincible when falling off the Stage.

notes.title: 【Announcing Update Version 2.1.0】
notes.notes:
[h3]The update to version 2.1.0 will be on July/5 (JST 12:00) for balance adjustment and bug fixes.[/h3]

We are aware of the issue where the game balance becomes significantly skewed under certain tactics,
and plan to implement countermeasures in the next update scheduled for the end of July.

As a temporary measure, we have removed "damage nullification" from the effect of the guard.

If you experience unpleasant behavior while playing the game, please make use of the block and report functions.

Details of the update are as follows.

[h3]◆Gameplay Rebalance[/h3]
[b]【Battle Balance】
▼Monster[/b]
   ・Monsters now recover HP when they prey on Busters.
   ・The "unable to get up" time when "Buddha" collapses has been extended.
   ・The available time to use the skill of "Buddha" has been shortened.
   ・The range of soul purification by "Buddha"'s skill has been narrowed.

[b]▼Undead[/b]
   ・Modified so that "Leech" remains near the ground when it takes damage.

[b]▼Gear[/b]
   ・The recovery amount from the Monster's "HP UP" gear has been halved.

[b]◆Function Adjustment[/b]
   ・Added a menu to make it easier to watch events afterwards
   －You can check from the Story Event in the options

[b]◆Bug Fixes[/b]
   ・Fixed a bug where you fall off the Stage, roll, and fall again.
   ・Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: 【Announcing Update Version 2.0.0】
notes.notes:
[h3]We are planning to roll out Ver2.0.0 on June 16 (JST 12:00) for the addition of new features and balance adjustments.[/h3]

In this major update, we aim to improve the aspects that were causing frustration while playing the game, such as "the joy of playing as Monsters," "decreasing the total annihilation rate of Busters," and "enhancing the overall game operability," with an intention to make the game enjoyable regardless of whether you're playing as Busters or Monsters!

The details of the update are as follows.

[h3]■ Update TOPIC[/h3]
　[b]◆ Common Changes[/b]
　・Adjustments have been made to reduce traction on the block and make it easier to move.
　・Both Busters and Monsters have been changed so that they can see each other's name tags. (Visible even through walls)
　・More items were added to score actions during battles, and changes were made so that EXP, Soul Coins, and Soul Gems could be earned in points accordingly.

　[b]◆ Monster[/b]
　・Changed to power-up based on the number of times a Buster is preyed upon and killed.
　　-Powering up makes the Monster's body progressively bigger, and its punches and other judgments become larger, making it easier to destroy blocks and prey on them.
　・The conditions for predation have been changed so that predation occurs when the Buster's HP is reduced to a certain degree and a punch is applied.
　・Changed to blow the Buster farther away immediately after killing the Buster with predation.
　・Changed to prevent Monsters from being mocked by Buster's kicks and punches and obstacles on the stage.
　・The double jump that was possible using walls has been changed to allow triple jumps.

　[b]◆ Buster[/b]
　・Changed when Buster is ghost state, they can be automatically revived over time.
　　-However, the time required for automatic revival increases according to the number of times the ghost state has been ghost state.
　・Changed to when in a ghost state, other Buster can be revived simply by contacting the Buster.
　・Changed it so that you can resurrect from a ghost state when you rescue a Buster who is being preyed upon with a ghost attack.
　・Changed ghost attacks and kicks are slightly homing against Monsters.
　　-When the kick hits the Monster, Monster and Buster behave as if they are bouncing off each other.
　・An alert function has been added whereby the screen frame turns red when a Monster is near itself.

[h3]■ Update Details[/h3]
※Some content may overlap with TOPIC.

　[b]◆New features[/b]
　・A free daily gacha has been added as a login bonus.
　・A stamp board function has been added, where stamps are accumulated according to battle results, coins and gems can be earned and stories can be released.

　・Upon opening the custom screen for the first time after the update, the following weapons will be unlocked and available for use. (If you already possess them, they will be converted to Soul Coins)
　　-Soul Pistol
　　-Soul Shotgun
　　-Soul Laser
　　-Soul Bomb
　　-Soul Machine Gun
　　-Soul Hammer
　　-Soul Bow & Arrow

　[b]◆Gameplay Rebalance[/b]
　【Rewards】
　・More items were added to score actions during battles, and changes were made so that EXP, Soul Coins, and Soul Gems could be earned in points accordingly.

　【Battle Balance】
　・Adjustments have been made to reduce traction on the block and make it easier to move.
　・Soul's contact detection has been increased.
　・Both Busters and Monsters have been changed so that they can see each other's name tags.

　[b]▼Buster[/b]
　・Changed when Buster is ghost state, they can be automatically revived over time.
　　-However, the time required for automatic revival increases according to the number of times the ghost state has been ghost state.
　・Changed to when in a ghost state, other Buster can be revived simply by contacting the Buster.
　・changed it so that you can resurrect from a ghost state when you rescue a Buster who is being preyed upon with a ghost attack.
　・Changed ghost attacks and kicks are slightly homing against Monsters.
　　-When the kick hits the Monster, Monster and Buster behave as if they are bouncing off each other.
　・Reduced stuck time after ghost attacks.
　・An alert function has been added whereby the screen frame turns red when a Monster is near itself.
　・The long press and hold recovery guard button has been removed and changed so that putting souls into the soul pot can recover all HP.
　・When approaching the undead, they are now automatically locked on when shot with Weapons. (Excluding some Weapons)
　・Adjusted to make it easier to get up when tripping over obstacles.
　・The cool time between defeating undead and the appearance of the soul has been removed.
　・Changed so that when a Monster's predation is cancelled, it becomes invincible for a certain period of time.
　・UI additions have been made to make it easier to locate souls and undead.
　・Adjusted the initial position of the Buster in all stages.

　[b]▼Monster[/b]
　・Changed to power-up based on the number of times a Buster is preyed upon and killed.
　　-Powering up makes the Monster's body progressively bigger, and its punches and other judgments become larger, making it easier to destroy blocks and prey on them.
　・The conditions for predation have been changed so that predation occurs when the Buster's HP is reduced to a certain degree and a punch is applied.

　・Adjusted to make it easier for punches to hit.

　[b]▼Skills[/b]

　　・The skill penetrates the block and explodes when it hits the ground.

　　・Slightly increased the "knockback" and "power" of the "Green Juice Laser", and made the "action during shot" slightly heavier.
　　・Increased the "knockback" and "power" of the "Blood Laser", and made the "action during shot" impossible.

　　・Shortened the "range" and lowered the "power" of the "Holstein Laser", "Future Spectrum", "DriverPro 20 Revision", and "Cream Ramune Laser".

notes.title: Announcing Update Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
The update to version 1.2.0 will be released on January /26 (12:00 JST) and will include bug fixes, and game balance adjustments.

The details of the update are as follows.

◆Improving Matchmaking
・Busters can keep their teammates to the next match by selecting ""Continue"" together when a match is over.
・It is now possible to match without a Monster player, which makes it possible to find a game with Buster players only. (Previously, you needed at least 1 Buster and 1 Monster player to start a match.)
・Matchmaking scale adjustment

notes.title: Announcing Update Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. This will be our first update after the feedback we have received from you. We wanted to thank everyone for your opinions, feedback and patience. More updates will come to improve the game for a better experience and we hope you will stay with us.
The update to version 1.0.2 will be on December/16 (12:00 JST) and will include new features, bug fixes, and game balance adjustments..

The details of the update are as follows.

Regarding global matching, it has been set to not restrict matchmaking.
We will continue to make quick adjustments and updates to the matchmaking system as we view the system and receive feedback from the players.

◆New Content
“Training” mode has been added.
　You can join from the Training in the lower right corner of the main menu.
　You can play CPU matches with the character and equipment selected on the Custom screen.
　Levels and ratings will not be affected.

◆Game Balance
[Rewards]
- When a player is eliminated from an Episode Match, they can earn some EXP as a reward.

[Balancing Battles]
- The "time until Souls appear" when an undead is defeated has been shortened.
- The "time of inactivity after falling" from the stage has been lengthened.
- When the Buster attacks a Monster, the Monster's HP bar and mini-map will be visible to all Busters for a certain period of time.
- The "movement speed" on uphill slopes is slower.
- The mini-map has been updated to show terrain and undead spawning locations.

▼ Buster
- The invincibility time after reviving from a ghost is longer.
- When a "ghost" player falls off the map, they will drop their Souls and return to the map in a tripped state.
- The "knockback" of the「shotgun」and「pistol」has been adjusted.
- The "minimum damage" of the「shotgun」has been increased.
- 「Shotgun」at close range have been made easier to hit.
- The bullets of the "Pistol" have been adjusted to hit easier.
- Healer's healing amount has been reduced.
- Healer damage has been increased.
- The "fire rate" of the "Healer" has decreased.


▼ Monster
- "Faster skill cooldown" near the end of battle is now weaker.
- Increased the size of the "Predation range".
- Predation is now quicker after the button is pressed.
- The "time to complete Predation" for "Kigurumee" skill has been lengthened.
- The behavior of the skills for "Oculus" and "Sakanamon" has been changed.
- The duration of burn caused by the Mythical Dragon skill has been lengthened.
- Reduced the amount of burn damage caused by the Dragon Head skill.

▼ Undead
- The "shield defense range" for "Cuttle" has been reduced.

[Stage/Map]
- The "Soul Pot" has been adjusted for less collision with the player.
- The number of "trippable objects" in the "Deep Forest" has been reduced.
- When colliding with trippable objects in succession, the player will not trip over until the player is away from the trippable objects for a certain range.
- Fixed the "fence collision" to be only during jumping.

◆Other Adjustments
- Improved the matchmaking for Episode Matches.
- In Episode Matches, the winning player can no longer punch, kick, or activate shots/skills during the results.
- In Episode Matches, when a player enters the match as a buster, matchmaking will be stopped when the player is close to winning.
- The volume of "ZITABATA" of SAKANAMON collaboration music has been lowered.

◆Bug fixes
- Fixed an issue that prevented keyboard/mouse control on the Steam version.
　When any key or button is pressed on the title screen, it will be recognized as "keyboard/mouse" or "gamepad".
- Fixed a problem in which the game did respond properly after key configuration.
- Fixed an issue that caused an error when matchmaking in Episode Matches on the PS5 version.
- Fixed an issue that caused some Monsters' rapid ranged skills to become more powerful with button mashing.
- Fixed an issue that caused Monsters to continue Predation on busters when they were in a ghost state.
- Fixed an issue that caused Souls to drop on blocks with trippable objects such as fences, stones, and tree roots.
- Fixed an issue that prevented players from acquiring Souls, even if they did not have any Souls, when multiple Souls were present.
- Fixed an issue that caused the camera to be inverted.
- Fixed other minor bugs.
